rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00021567, epochs=5, batch_size=1, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1120, seed=42, rationale=iter-12 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). START FROM iter-7 CHAMPION (c24/ep5/lr2.16e-4/alpha0.0025734/bs2, hr 0.8469). ONE KNOB: batch_size 2 -> 1. All else = champion exactly (itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=2.16e-4, epochs=5, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) champion iter-7 (c24/ep5/bs2): 0.8469. TRAINING RECIPE now mapped: lr unimodal-optimal at 2.16e-4 (iter-9 3.5e-4->0.8398, iter-10 1.5e-4->0.8415), alpha_init INERT (iter-11 0.005->0.8459 = tie, learnable alpha self-corrects). (2) FAILURE MODE / lever: the c24 net was EPOCH-BUDGET-LIMITED (epochs still climbing at ep5 but the wall caps it). batch_size 2->1 DOUBLES the number of gradient UPDATES per epoch (2400 steps/epoch vs 1200) at the SAME data and ~same total compute -- effectively buys the extra optimization the epoch budget couldn't, and small-batch noise often generalizes better. This is the last un-probed training lever before seed replicates. (3) ONE KNOB: batch_size 2 -> 1 (2x gradient updates/epoch; c/k/lr/alpha/epochs/train_n held). (4) HYPOTHESIS: bs=1 lifts hr above 0.8469 because 2x more optimizer steps on the epoch-budget-limited c24 net converges further, and small-batch gradient noise regularizes toward a flatter minimum on the 200-case val split. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.8469 at bs=1, the champion bs=2 is already optimal (or bs=1's noisier gradients hurt) -> the training recipe is fully exhausted and iters 13+ become SEED-ROBUSTNESS replicates of the champion to establish the leaderboard mean+/-std. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): bs=1 vs bs=2 keeps total forward/backward work ~constant (same samples/epoch) but doubles optimizer-step + python-loop overhead; iter-7 bs2 = 939.5s, worst observed same-config node variance = 1093.9s (iter-9). bs=1 overhead adds maybe +5-8pct -> predicted ~1000-1150s = 16.7-19.2min < 1200s. max_train_s=1120 fences the TRAIN phase so even on a slow node a finite val+figure land inside the 30-min sbatch wall. train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap; bs=1 uses LESS peak GPU mem than bs=2). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-12 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-13.
